scope: One synthetic32record NDJSON history with complete explicit global/current selected records; strict all-source validation, physical positions and oracle equivalence. Two fresh no-tool native total input+output observations. Excludes actual retrieval chain, whole-workflow/cash/long-horizon claims.

implementation.procedure: Read actual shared parser, API and CLI; exact source snapshot; reviewer independent code inspection.
implementation.acceptance: No default behavior regression or semantic/parser disagreement.

reference_boundary.procedure: Independent expected heading/line oracle, exact selected text and full-source hash; negative tests.
reference_boundary.acceptance: Comments/ambiguous titles/invalid fences/stale SHA/UTF8/budgets/links fail without partial output.

data_integrity.procedure: Freeze every influencing code/input/config/environment; preserve all raw provider RPC and rejected attempts.
data_integrity.acceptance: Exactly two admitted fresh calls, no retries/rerouting/tools; full observed instruction/settings controls equal.

numerical_sanity.procedure: Recompute usage from original native notifications including output/reasoning; verify oracle equality.
numerical_sanity.acceptance: Finite baseline_total > candidate_total, all actual pair usage included; no cache subtraction or cash claim.

measurement_validity.procedure: Same question/output schema/model/effort/non-task instructions/tools. Candidate includes discovery AND selected-view packets; baseline full advice AND same selected-view packet.
measurement_validity.acceptance: Same task/available heading list/global text/selected constraints; only historical bodies omitted; recovery-required decisions use full source instead.

reproducibility.procedure: Independent context reruns CPU reconstruction and tests, inspects source controls and original events.
reproducibility.acceptance: Authenticated separate reviewer, frozen plan/source, positive scoped evidence with explicit limitations.
